sources.title: Foreigners Residence Law No. 76 of 2017
sources.publisher: Official Gazette of Iraq / Ministry of Justice
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry of Justice hosts the Official Gazette text, labelled Issue No. 4466 and dated 23 October 2017.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The provisions of this law shall not be applied to Iraqis and their children who hold foreign passports.

sources.title: Iraqi Electronic Visa: live visa search and issuance guidance
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Directorate of Residency Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live federal page identifies evisa.iq as the official Directorate of Residence Affairs website of the Iraqi Ministry of Interior and exposes the country-and-passport-type search.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Search for visa requirements by your country and passport type.

sources.title: Iraqi Electronic Visa: live electronic issuance description
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Directorate of Residency Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live MOI eVisa page describes delivery and border use of an electronically issued visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Your e-Visa will arrive by email; print it and show it at border control.

sources.title: Electronic Visa
sources.publisher: Consulate General of the Republic of Iraq in Los Angeles / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Iraqi Ministry of Foreign Affairs consulate page directs applicants to the Iraqi electronic visa platform.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Apply for an entry visa to Iraq electronically through the Iraqi electronic visa platform.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Directorate of Residency Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The current MOI instruction page exposes the country/passport-type search; its live country endpoint returns no country records.
